COST: 212

Notes on the plan:
- I read the Gosaikunda report as 4 injured, 2 adult labourers and 3 pupils (9 people in total). The Kakani, Jwalamukhi and Naukunda counts follow the same reading.
- Only kalika-shelter and dhunche-hospital are designated evacuation points. Jwalamukhi school and Syaphru care home are used only as pass-through points.
- The Kalika–Syaphru road is flooded and the Belkot–Gajuri road is blocked, so neither is used. Gosaikunda is reachable only from Dhunche in this network, so car2 must serve it alone.
- Deferring one adult from Gosaikunda is the cheapest way to cut a whole 46-minute round trip. It costs 20 in penalty, so it saves 26 minutes net. Every other person is rescued because deferring them would cost more than the driving needed to reach them.
- Total cost: car1 28 + car2 72 (Jwalamukhi and Naukunda) + car2 92 (Gosaikunda) + penalty 20 = 212.
